name: Primidone
summary: Primidone (Mysoline) is a seizure medicine related to phenobarbital, used for several types of seizures and for essential tremor.
description: Primidone, sold under the brand name Mysoline, is an anticonvulsant (seizure medicine) related to the barbiturates. Your body turns it into phenobarbital and another substance called PEMA, and both help control seizures. Primidone can control tonic-clonic (grand mal), complex partial seizures and focal seizures, as well as essential tremor. It is taken by mouth. It starts working slowly but gives long-lasting seizure control.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Primidone, marketed under the brand name Mysoline, is a barbiturate-derived anticonvulsant. It is structurally related to phenobarbital and is metabolized into phenobarbital and phenylethylmalonamide (PEMA), both of which contribute to its antiepileptic effects. Primidone is effective in controlling tonic-clonic (grand mal), complex partial (psychomotor), and focal seizures, as well as essential tremor. It is taken orally and has a slow onset of action but provides long-lasting seizure control.
